subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Arnaldo Tovar is a prominent American cellist who graduated from the Juilliard School.
• He has won several regional classical music competitions.
• He is best known for a 2019 TikTok video that has been viewed over five million times.
• The video shows him performing a classical arrangement of a popular hip-hop song.
• Tovar combines traditional classical technique with contemporary musical styles in the video.
prompt: The student wants to emphasize Tovar's most well-known achievement. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Arnaldo Tovar is best known for a 2019 TikTok video performance of a classical hip-hop arrangement that has been viewed over five million times.
choices.B: Arnaldo Tovar, who has won several regional classical music competitions, has also combined traditional classical technique with contemporary musical styles.
choices.C: Among his many achievements, prominent American cellist Arnaldo Tovar graduated from the Juilliard School and has won several regional classical music competitions.
choices.D: Classical arrangements of popular hip-hop songs combine traditional classical technique with contemporary musical styles.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. This describes the achievement for which Tovar is best known.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect. This choice doesn't emphasize Tovar's most well-known achievement—it describes several of his achievements equally.
